# Security and Privacy Requirements Checklist: Remote Skill Delivery MVP

**Purpose**: Review whether authentication, tenant isolation, repository privacy, retrieval safety,
cache integrity, erasure, and untrusted-content requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and
objectively assessable.
**Created**: 2026-08-11
**Feature**: [Remote Skill Delivery MVP](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context
and requirements. It evaluates the requirements themselves, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Do bearer-authentication requirements cover all six MCP operations and require
  authentication before catalog access, repository-memory access, or argument-dependent error
  disclosure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the complete API-key lifecycle specified, including issuance, one-time secret
  display, storage, expiry, overlapping rotation, revocation, account disabling, and loss or
  compromise recovery? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Do credential-storage requirements enumerate the permitted stored key fields, digest
  construction, pepper separation, secret non-recoverability, and forbidden log or command-line
  exposure? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are tenant-isolation requirements defined for every read and mutation path, including
  search ranking, remembered usage, outcomes, listing, erasure, and audit events? [Completeness,
  Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-019–FR-030]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is repository privacy defined as an allowlist of persisted memory fields as well as a
  prohibition on source code, paths, files, secrets, prompts, raw Git metadata, and identifiable
  repository details? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021–FR-023, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK006 - Do SSRF-prevention requirements cover MCP schemas, unknown input fields, shared
  application types, catalog configuration, current provider behavior, and future network-provider
  boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are resource-safety requirements complete for normalization, manifest declaration,
  containment, symlinks, file type, text validation, byte limits, and integrity verification before
  content becomes available or cacheable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014–FR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 - Does repository-erasure coverage include usage rows, outcomes, all exact revisions in
  the account/repository scope, transactional failure behavior, restart behavior, and concurrent
  operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-028–FR-029, Spec §SC-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are untrusted-content requirements explicit for Markdown, plain-text resources,
  embedded commands or code samples, invalid text, binary data, hooks, scripts, packages, and other
  executable-looking content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-017–FR-018]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 - Is the bearer-token grammar unambiguous about the public key identifier, secret
  encoding, secret entropy, accepted whitespace, case sensitivity, and malformed-token handling?
  [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the API-key digest rule precise about the keyed hash algorithm, digest input,
  comparison behavior, pepper source, and behavior when the pepper is unavailable? [Clarity, Gap,
  Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are pepper rotation and pepper-compromise recovery requirements defined without
  making existing API-key secrets recoverable? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is “revoked” defined as terminal, and is the point when revocation becomes effective
  specified for new requests, authenticated in-flight requests, and cached authentication results?
  [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is an account-wide API key's authority stated clearly, including that repository
  hashes do not provide additional authorization and that no key can select another account?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the permitted use of the raw repository hash clear: persisted only in repository
  memory, treated as opaque, never enriched, and replaced by a non-reversible correlation value in
  logs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021–FR-022, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the prohibition on arbitrary URL inputs clear enough to distinguish URL-like text
  inside a natural-language task from a caller-selected fetch target? [Clarity, Ambiguity,
  Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the resource-path normalization sequence specified precisely enough for percent
  decoding, separators, dot segments, platform-specific absolute paths, NULs, symlinks, and
  duplicate normalized paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016–FR-018, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are every request, instruction, resource, manifest-count, and complete-revision size
  limit quantified, with the measurement stage and UTF-8 byte semantics stated explicitly?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-031, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is a “complete cached copy” defined by exact revision identity, full manifest and
  resource presence, fresh hash verification, and rejection of any extra or mismatched content?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is “completely erase” scoped explicitly to transactional deletion from the one
  authoritative live database with no repository-memory cache or invalidation step, with
  privacy-safe audit expiry and operator-managed backups and WAL identified as outside the API
  guarantee?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 - Are the blanket authentication requirement for MCP operations and the documented
  unauthenticated health endpoints consistent and clearly separated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002,
  Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 - Do all artifacts consistently derive account identity from bearer authentication
  rather than from MCP arguments, repository hashes, catalog data, or persisted caller claims?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is idempotent, existence-hiding erasure consistent with auditability requirements and
  with the prohibition on leaking whether another tenant or repository scope exists? [Consistency,
  Spec §FR-028–FR-032]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the current no-network catalog requirement consistent with the future provider
  seam, so later network retrieval cannot silently introduce caller-controlled hosts, redirects, or
  revisions without a separate specification? [Consistency, Assumption, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are immutable `trustAtPublication` and derived `currentAdvisoryStatus` consistently
  distinguished from the rule that every skill document and resource remains untrusted input?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are cached responses subject to the same authentication, tenant isolation, content
  validation, provenance, rate, audit, and failure-disclosure requirements as fresh retrieval?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-030–FR-032]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK027 - Can authentication acceptance criteria objectively distinguish missing, malformed,
  unknown, digest-mismatched, expired, revoked, and disabled-account credentials without revealing
  which condition occurred? [Measurability, Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK028 - Does SC-006 define zero cross-tenant disclosure and mutation across every memory and
  ranking operation, including two accounts presenting the same repository hash? [Measurability,
  Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are repository-privacy and log-redaction outcomes measurable for success, rejection,
  unexpected-error, rate-limit, deletion, and audit paths? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap,
  Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-032]
- [ ] CHK030 - Does SC-008 define a sufficiently exhaustive rejection matrix for URL/source fields,
  path encodings, symlinks, file types, size boundaries, and malicious text content? [Acceptance
  Criteria, Spec §SC-008, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are cache-integrity outcomes measurable for valid, incomplete, poisoned, stale,
  cross-revision, and hash-mismatched cache entries? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-014, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 - Can direct live-row erasure, the absence of repository-memory caching, restart
  non-resurrection, idempotent existence-hiding responses, unconditional logical audit expiry, and
  the availability-qualified one-hour physical-cleanup bound be assessed objectively?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 - Are key-rotation scenarios defined for successful overlap, old-key revocation, new-key
  failure, lost keys, suspected compromise, and disabled accounts? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are race scenarios addressed when revocation or repository erasure overlaps with an
  already authenticated request, a remembered load, an outcome update, or a retry? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are tenant scenarios complete for multiple keys in one account, identical repository
  hashes across accounts, different repository hashes in one account, and revoked keys attempting
  prior scopes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are path-attack scenarios defined for raw and encoded traversal, double encoding,
  POSIX and Windows absolute forms, backslashes, NULs, overly long paths, symlinks, and
  time-of-check/time-of-use replacement? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are source and cache recovery requirements complete when the source is unavailable,
  the cache is absent, verification times out, or only part of a revision is valid? [Coverage,
  Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are malicious-content scenarios specified for executable-looking Markdown, package
  instructions, scripts, hooks, binary bytes, invalid UTF-8, NULs, and content that exceeds limits
  before or after normalization? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-017–FR-018]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are rollback and safe-disclosure requirements defined when persistence, deletion,
  audit emission, validation, or cache population fails partway through an operation? [Coverage,
  Exception Flow, Gap]
